title: TSMC details pricing, confirms agentic AI boosts CPU demand
key_facts: Digitimes says TSMC addressed pricing, CPUs and advanced packaging at its 15 Oct 2026 earnings briefing.
It says demand for CPUs tied to agentic AI continues to rise as overall AI demand stays strong.
BigGo call summary: C.C. Wei, TSMC chairman and CEO, said there is increasing demand from agentic AI CPUs, but did not say demand is shifting away from accelerators.
Wei said CPUs are not counted in TSMC's AI accelerator demand forecast.
Wei said pricing depends on market segment, location and technology, and that US production will be priced differently.
quote_evidence: TSMC addressed pricing adjustments, CPUs, and advanced packaging at its earnings briefing on October 15, 2026, confirming that demand for CPUs related to agentic AI continues to rise as overall AI demand remains strong.
why_it_matters_hint: Server CPUs for AI agents are becoming a growth line for TSMC besides AI accelerators.
notes: Digitimes page is paywalled after one paragraph; extra detail taken from BigGo's summary of the call transcript and labelled as such.
